name: Lakewood Center
description:
Lakewood Center represents one of the crown achievements of American regional shopping mall development. Spanning 2.1 million square feet, this Southern California institution serves as the second-largest mall in the Los Angeles area and one of the most significant retail destinations in Southern California. Opened in 1952, Lakewood Center has been a cornerstone of community commerce for over seven decades, continuously adapting and reinventing itself to remain relevant in an ever-changing retail landscape.

The center's impressive portfolio includes over 225 retail stores, major anchor tenants including Macy's, JCPenney, Target, Costco, and a sprawling Forever 21 flagship location. This diverse tenant mix ensures that Lakewood Center serves multiple shopping needs—from everyday essentials and grocery shopping to fashion-forward retail and entertainment-focused experiences. The mall's "Restaurant Row" has emerged as a particularly popular destination, offering diverse dining options including George's Greek Café and Outback Steakhouse that complement the retail experience.

What makes Lakewood Center particularly appealing is its focus on accessibility and value. The center thoughtfully integrates practical shopping destinations—including a large Costco, Target, and numerous other value-oriented retailers—alongside traditional mall retail, creating a comprehensive shopping environment that appeals to price-conscious families and everyday shoppers. The addition of specialty retailers like Sephora within JCPenney and the newly opened Papaya store demonstrates the mall's commitment to staying current with consumer trends.

As a super-regional shopping destination, Lakewood Center attracts consistent, high-volume foot traffic from both the surrounding Long Beach-Lakewood community and visitors throughout greater Los Angeles. The mall's one-level layout (with select multi-level stores) makes navigation convenient, while its extensive parking facilities accommodate the high visitor volume. For over 70 years, Lakewood Center has proven itself an essential retail hub that successfully balances practical shopping needs with entertainment and leisure experiences.
